content: With the same learning rate and weight decay we apply a 5-fold cross-validation on the outputs and take the mean across the folds as our ensemble. We sample 20 random seeds (see more in section SECREF26 ) to find the best initialization for our gradient descent search. From these samples, we select the best validation F1 metric or Mean Squared Error (MSE) for use in our test submission.
